notes: One STL designed to retain with the original spring clamp. Strong non-critical pilot lead, but fitment is asserted by the archive and has not been independently checked on a 993 console. 2026-10-15: same asset as SRC-PRINTABLES-964-993-CONSOLE-SWITCH-TAB (Printables model 1369571). On 2026-10-15 the original Printables page (model 1369571) was not readable: printables.com/robots.txt allows all agents except /world/, but the model page returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge ('Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client. The Internet Archive index lists a capture of that page dated 2025-09-12 (HTTP 200); it was not read, because the page-reading tool refuses web.archive.org. The CC-BY (no version) statement rests only on the secondary archive, so redistribution is set to unknown, as for every Renn 3D Parts record, until the licence is read on the original page. 2026-11-05 (owner decision: Internet Archive captures count as provenance evidence): the Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/20250912155210/https://www.printables.com/model/1369571-porsche-964-993-center-console-switch-tab (raw HTML, 181,151 bytes, SHA-256 in docs/research/public-3d-asset-archive-licence-pass-2026-11-05.md) was read with a plain HTTP client. Its title names the author 9khil; its embedded page data gives licence id 1, which the same capture names 'Creative Commons — Attribution', with no version. This agrees with the Renn 3D Parts declaration, so the licence is archive-verified and redistribution is attribution_required. The capture also shows the model is a remix of Thingiverse thing 4826642 'Porsche 964 Center' by Naischnotz (CC Attribution), so attribution must name both authors. No model file was downloaded.
